# IndiaMART
> IndiaMART is India’s largest B2B marketplace connecting buyers with manufacturers, suppliers, exporters, and service providers across industries.

IndiaMART operates as a business directory, product discovery platform, and lead-generation marketplace for trade in India. It helps businesses source products, compare suppliers, request quotations, explore catalogs, and connect directly with verified sellers across industrial, commercial, and consumer categories.

## Main Platform
- [IndiaMART Homepage](https://www.indiamart.com/): Main marketplace for discovering products, suppliers, manufacturers, and exporters across India.
- [Mobile Site](https://m.indiamart.com/): Mobile-optimized version of the IndiaMART marketplace for browsing and inquiries.
- [Products Directory](https://dir.indiamart.com/): Category-based product directory covering industrial, business, and commercial product listings.
- [Sellers Directory](https://www.indiamart.com/impcat/): Browse supplier and manufacturer categories across major business segments.
- [Trade Leads](https://www.indiamart.com/trade-leads/): Marketplace area for buyer requirements and seller lead discovery.
- [Request for Quotation](https://www.indiamart.com/request-for-quotation/): Submit buying requirements and receive quotations from relevant suppliers.

## Product Categories
- [Building & Construction](https://dir.indiamart.com/impcat/building-construction-material-machinery.html): Products and suppliers for construction materials, machinery, and infrastructure needs.
- [Industrial Plants & Machinery](https://dir.indiamart.com/impcat/industrial-plants-machinery.html): Industrial machinery, equipment, and plant solutions from Indian suppliers.
- [Electronics & Electrical](https://dir.indiamart.com/impcat/electronics-electrical-supplies.html): Electrical equipment, components, and electronics supply categories.
- [Food & Agriculture](https://dir.indiamart.com/impcat/food-agriculture-products.html): Agricultural products, food items, and related processing supplies.
- [Apparel & Garments](https://dir.indiamart.com/impcat/apparel-garments.html): Clothing, textiles, and garment manufacturing supplier listings.
- [Packaging & Printing](https://dir.indiamart.com/impcat/packaging-machines-goods.html): Packaging materials, printing services, and packaging machinery categories.
- [Chemicals, Dyes & Solvents](https://dir.indiamart.com/impcat/chemicals-dyes-solvents.html): Chemical products, industrial solvents, and dye supplier listings.
- [Medical & Healthcare](https://dir.indiamart.com/impcat/medical-equipment.html): Medical devices, healthcare supplies, and hospital equipment categories.

## Buyer Tools
- [Post Buy Requirement](https://www.indiamart.com/post-buy-requirement/): Create a buying request to receive responses from matching suppliers.
- [Get Best Price](https://www.indiamart.com/get-best-price/): Inquiry flow for collecting supplier quotes on listed products.
- [Buy Leads](https://www.indiamart.com/trade-leads/buy-leads.html): Explore active buyer requirements and sourcing opportunities.
- [Search Products](https://www.indiamart.com/search.mp?ss=industrial): Search interface for finding products and suppliers by keyword.
- [Seller Contact Pages](https://www.indiamart.com/company/): Company profile area for supplier details, catalogs, and contact options.
- [Product Catalog Pages](https://www.indiamart.com/proddetail/): Product detail pages with specifications, pricing prompts, and seller information.

## Seller Tools
- [Sell on IndiaMART](https://seller.indiamart.com/): Seller onboarding portal for listing products and generating business leads.
- [Seller Login](https://seller.indiamart.com/login/): Access seller account tools for managing leads, catalogs, and profile details.
- [Start Selling](https://seller.indiamart.com/start-selling/): Entry point for businesses beginning their seller journey on IndiaMART.
- [Lead Manager](https://seller.indiamart.com/leadmanager/): Seller workspace for reviewing and responding to buyer inquiries.
- [Catalog Management](https://seller.indiamart.com/catalog/): Manage product listings, catalogs, and business profile content.
- [TrustSEAL](https://seller.indiamart.com/trustseal/): Verification and credibility program for supplier profiles on the marketplace.

## Company & Supplier Discovery
- [Manufacturers Directory](https://www.indiamart.com/manufacturers.html): Directory of manufacturers across product and industry categories.
- [Suppliers Directory](https://www.indiamart.com/suppliers.html): Directory of suppliers serving domestic and international business buyers.
- [Exporters Directory](https://www.indiamart.com/exporters.html): Exporter listings for businesses serving overseas markets.
- [Wholesalers Directory](https://www.indiamart.com/wholesalers.html): Wholesaler listings across commercial and industrial product categories.
- [Service Providers](https://www.indiamart.com/service-provider.html): Business service providers across technical, commercial, and operational domains.
- [Local Suppliers](https://www.indiamart.com/city/): City-based supplier discovery for regional sourcing and procurement.

- [Lab Instruments & Supplies](https://dir.indiamart.com/impcat/lab-instruments-supplies.html): Laboratory instruments, testing equipment, and scientific supplies.

## Support & Account
- [Help Center](https://help.indiamart.com/): Support resources for buyers and sellers using IndiaMART services.
- [Contact Us](https://www.indiamart.com/contactus.html): Contact options for customer support, sales, and business inquiries.
- [Feedback](https://www.indiamart.com/feedback.html): Submit platform feedback and report issues or suggestions.
- [Buyer Login](https://my.indiamart.com/): Buyer account area for managing inquiries and activity.
- [Sign In](https://login.indiamart.com/): Unified login entry point for IndiaMART user accounts.
- [Register](https://login.indiamart.com/register/): Account registration flow for new IndiaMART users.
